verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API for automating my.anydesk account data, but nothing in the evidence shows issuing API credentials, let alone credentials scoped to least-privilege permissions for an agent. The documented organization user roles and permissions are an adjacent control, not scoped API credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
